description: This Kotlin source file defines a CameraCaptureManager class responsible for managing camera operations such as listing devices, capturing images, and recording videos on an Android device using CameraX API and related libraries. It handles permissions, device selection, image processing, and video recording lifecycle.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages camera device listing, image capture, and video recording functionalities, handling permissions, device selection, and image/video processing on Android.

methods.name: attachLifecycleOwner
methods.description: Associates a LifecycleOwner with the CameraCaptureManager for camera lifecycle management.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Sets a PermissionRequester instance to handle runtime permission requests.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: ensureCameraPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests CAMERA permission if not already granted.

methods.name: ensureMicPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests RECORD_AUDIO permission if not already granted.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo, processes it, and returns its representation as a Payload.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip with optional audio, then returns file info encapsulated in FilePayload.

methods.name: rotateBitmapByExif
methods.description: Corrects bitmap orientation based on EXIF data.

methods.name: parseFacing
methods.description: Parses camera facing direction from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseQuality
methods.description: Parses image quality setting from JSON.

methods.name: parseMaxWidth
methods.description: Parses max width parameter for image scaling.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses duration in milliseconds for recording.

methods.name: parseDeviceId
methods.description: Parses device ID from JSON parameters.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses whether to include audio in video recording.

methods.name: resolveCameraSelector
methods.description: Resolves the camera selector based on device ID or facing direction.

methods.name: cameraDeviceInfoOrNull
methods.description: Extracts camera device info object from CameraInfo, including ID, name, position, and type.

methods.name: cameraIdOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves camera ID string from CameraInfo when available.

methods.name: cameraProvider
methods.description: Suspends until a ProcessCameraProvider instance is retrieved.

methods.name: takeJpegWithExif
methods.description: Captures an image as JPEG and retrieves EXIF orientation data.
